battery.note: Conservative prototype reserve only. Replace with selected cell vendor swelling and protection-board data.

gasket.note: Concept target only; final value depends on selected elastomer cross-section, hardness and groove design.

camera.note: Final lens stack and shutter mechanism require selected vendor CAD and ingress testing.

crown_generator.note: Reserve for shaft, seal, bearing/generator tolerances; final mechanism not selected.

flex.note: Generic concept gate; final rigid-flex stackup and vendor bend guidance supersede this.

antenna.note: No fixed millimetre keep-out asserted until the antenna vendor/reference design is selected.

thermal.note: Thermal simulation and prototype thermocouple testing required before enclosure freeze.

variant_notes.NG46: More packaging margin; preferred first target for rotor and crown-generator prototypes.
variant_notes.NG40: Higher packaging risk. Rotor and camera may be dropped if DFM or thermal gates fail.
